name: find_shared_deadlines
description: For a 'Check for work' run: reads the connected calendars of every group member and returns assignments/exams that two or more members share (same piece of work, due within 48 hours of each other). Matching is already done for you - each match lists exactly which members have it. Also reports who hasn't connected their calendar. Never returns anyone's unmatched items.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to look, 1-30. Default 14.
